sentences.en: Consequently, Potter's multiculturalist diagnosis - apparently mutual respect will solve our crisis - carries little cinematic weight.

sentences.en: Thus we have a director developing an oeuvre that combines social concerns with genuine cinematic expression.

sentences.en: The panels contained three or four cells each, and remain truer to Fleming's original literary tails than the later cinematic outings.
